evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: müssen jederzeit verlässlich, performant und aussagekräftig sein
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD requires BI solutions to always be reliable, performant, and meaningful, and responsibilities include upgrade/function testing, with no velocity/speed language, making this rigour-dominant.
evidence.domain_risk: Unsere Business-Intelligence-Lösungen bilden die Grundlage für fundierte, datengetriebene Entscheidungen im gesamten Unternehmen
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Hetzner is a hosting/data center operator with no financial-reporting or regulatory-specific language in the JD, placing this at moderate risk since it informs company-wide decisions but isn't itself regulated.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Um diese BI-Landschaft kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln, auszubauen und zu betreiben
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing BI landscape/platform is already operating and being continuously developed and expanded, indicating a growing mid-stage function rather than greenfield.
evidence.jd_authorship: Betrieb und Administration der BI-Plattform, einschließlich Benutzerverwaltung, Archivierung, Monitoring der Ladeprozesse sowie Durchführung von Upgrade- und Funktionstests
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities name concrete operational tasks (BI platform administration, user management, load monitoring, upgrade/function testing) that describe exactly what the person does day to day.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachabteilungen zur Aufnahme und Priorisierung von Anforderungen
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role centers on building and operating the internal BI/data platform itself and translating business questions into self-service data solutions, an internal-data-function orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: Du arbeitest eng mit den Fachabteilungen zusammen, übersetzt fachliche Fragestellungen in moderne Dashboards, Reports und Self-Service-Lösungen
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role translates business requirements into dashboards/reports and operates the existing BI platform rather than setting overall data strategy, indicating execution.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tooling or AI-consuming infrastructure requirement is mentioned anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Upgrade and functional testing appear as an operational task within platform administration duties, without a broader testing/data-quality ownership framing, so tool_listed.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: müssen jederzeit verlässlich, performant und aussagekräftig sein... zentralen Beitrag zur Transparenz, Datenqualität und Entscheidungsfähigkeit
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Reliability, data quality, and decision-making transparency are named as central concerns but without regulatory/compliance framing, placing this at moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Planung, Anbindung, Integration und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung von Datenquellen inklusive Datenmodellierung, Datentransformation und Optimierung bestehender Datenstrukturen
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role both connects/integrates new data sources and optimizes existing data structures within an established BI landscape, a mixed signal.
